ev.q: A co-op horror about scavenging at abandoned moons
The atmosphere and horror can't be beat
So many fond memories of me and friends being terrified and having hilarious moments
collect scrap from abandoned, industrialized moons
Genuinely have not gotten tired of the gameplay loop
It is only fun with friends and gets very repetitive
Amazon warehouse work, but somehow worse
scanning any creature you find to add them to your bestiary
